title: Map Operation Log
description: design/map-generation.md §6: an ordered, append-only list of edits. Render = import the base World, then replay every operation in order -- never a destructive edit. Op coordinates are lon/lat, never frame-relative metres, because a frame's centre/rotation/extent are exactly the parameters an art-direction session sweeps most, and lon/lat survives all three (see citymap/ops/log.py's module docstring). Each operation's shape beyond id/op/when/note is owned by that op kind's own module (citymap/ops/construct.py, citymap/ops/demolish.py, ...) rather than pre-declared here, so adding a new op kind (crater/excavate/reclaim/...) is a self-contained addition, not a schema change.

id.description: Unique within the log. Namespaces every feature id this op produces (see ids.op_feature_id) -- replaying the log must reproduce identical ids, so this can never be regenerated or reordered.

when.description: Campaign-time label (e.g. an episode/scene id) this op is attached to. Free-form; not interpreted by the replay engine.

note.description: Human rationale -- why this scar exists, for the GM reading the log later.
